mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS level, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 305, persistent inflation signals heightened risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0 and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 102.5, overheating economy signals imminent slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 AND INDPRO < 102.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0), heightened risk aversion compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) signal strong economic growth and rising corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite HOUST level, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102.0, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) are both below their 1-year moving averages, it signals a weakening housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1350 AND RSAFS < 700000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
